title: Create task returns 201 with server-generated UUID and documented defaults
brd_criteria_text: FR2: POST a task with title, optional description, optional status; returns 201 with a server-generated UUID and documented defaults for omitted fields.

title: PATCH updates fields and keeps unchanged fields
brd_criteria_text: FR3: GET returns the task list; PATCH and GET responses show updated values while omitted fields remain unchanged.

title: PATCH is atomic with no partial changes on failure
brd_criteria_text: FR4: PATCH accepts one or more of title, description, status as an atomic operation with no partial changes on failure.

title: DELETE returns 204 and 404 for missing
brd_criteria_text: FR5: DELETE a task returns 204 with no body; nonexistent IDs return 404.
